628:t_1:172.en:
$$セシル$$
「Reportedly, even what has been confirmed so far is already an overwhelming horde.」

628:t_1:173.en:
$$ラクシャータ$$
「Ugh, this is bad... If they had just waited one more month, we might have been able to do something about it...」

628:t_1:174.en:
$$ロイド$$
「One disaster passes and another one comes right behind it...」

628:t_1:175.en:
$$ロイド$$
「Humanity might be finished before that system of ours is completed, you know...」

628:t_2:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「...Who are you!? What are you seeking, that you came here!? Answer me!」

628:t_2:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「Answer me! What is your purpose...」

628:t_3:3.en: ～ $$フロンティア船団$$ Chief Aide's Office ～

628:t_3:4.en:
$$三島$$
「...So the $$バジュラ$$ live in symbiosis with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, huh.」

628:t_3:5.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「That is nothing to be surprised at. The two have a similar ecology.」

628:t_3:6.en:
$$三島$$
「Then can we not control the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ as well?」

628:t_3:8.en:
$$三島$$
「If we bring their power into our hands in addition to the $$バジュラ$$, our plan to conquer the galaxy becomes all the more realistic.」

628:t_3:9.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
(A man who did nothing but kowtow to the Empire, and now he reaches for things beyond his station...)

628:t_3:10.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「I understand what you want. But there is still a great deal we do not know about the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

628:t_3:11.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「Depending on the situation, we should keep leaving the $$地球圏$$ in view as an option.」

628:t_3:12.en:
$$三島$$
「Agreed. It also bothers me that $$バジュラ$$ swarms have started appearing in the $$地球圏$$ so often.」

628:t_3:13.en:
$$三島$$
「Could it be that they resent our controlling their swarms?」

628:t_3:14.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「But that works in our favor. We will fire $$インプラント$$ rounds into them and make them part of our forces.」

628:t_3:15.en:
$$三島$$
「Heh heh... The troublesome $$新地球皇国$$ will soon be withdrawing from Earth completely, too. The wind is fully in our favor.」

628:t_3:16.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「And there is more good news. By putting the $$バジュラ$$ under our control, we have also learned the location of their home planet.」

628:t_3:17.en:
$$三島$$
「We have already established that the $$バジュラ$$ Queen favors Earth-type planets. Which means...」

628:t_3:18.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「That place is our new land... Let us make it the planet where the ruler of the galaxy lives.」

628:t_3:19.en:
$$三島$$
「$$皇帝アウストラリス$$ has withdrawn, but I cannot imagine the $$サイデリアル$$ giving up on Earth.」

628:t_3:20.en:
$$三島$$
「In that case, let us quickly write off this backwater planet and carve out our own Frontier with our own hands.」

628:t_3:21.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「The arrival of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ looks like it could be the opportunity for that.」

628:t_3:22.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
(But what I do not understand is why the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, who were at the center of the galaxy, came to this backwater...)

628:t_3:23.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
(Was some kind of power at work there...)

628:t_3:27.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

628:t_3:29.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「He was taken to the Medical Room on the $$プトレマイオス$$.」

628:t_3:30.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「But they say he still hasn't regained consciousness...」

628:t_3:31.en:
$$カイエン$$
「If I had known it would come to this, I would have stopped him from attempting anything as reckless as dialogue...!」

628:t_3:32.en:
$$アマタ$$
「But $$刹那$$... I think he would have gone even if we had tried to stop him.」

628:t_3:33.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Mutual understanding through dialogue... So that is what he has taken as his own mission since the $$再世戦争$$...」

628:t_3:34.en:
$$アルト$$
「But in a state like this...」

628:t_3:35.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「And on top of that, even $$ティエリア$$...」

628:t_3:36.en:
$$アンディ$$
「That guy... At first glance he was a cool bastard who was hard to approach, but he was a hot-blooded guy who cared about his friends...」

628:t_3:38.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「$$ティエリア$$ wasn't like that when we first met... He was a man who put the mission first...」

628:t_3:39.en:
$$アルト$$
「But he kept changing. Through the $$破界事変$$ and the $$再世戦争$$, together with everyone in $$ソレスタルビーイング$$...」

628:t_3:42.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Damn...! What the hell are those $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ things...!」

628:t_3:44.en:
$$クレア$$
「It seems that gravity tremor really was the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ main force teleporting in.」

628:t_3:45.en:
$$シリウス$$
「They say a large force is gathering around the super-huge $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ that appeared there.」

628:t_3:46.en:
$$アポロ$$
「And that thing is closing in on Earth...!」

628:t_3:47.en:
$$クレア$$
「The $$連邦軍$$ has called on the remnants of $$ネオ・ジオン$$ to cooperate, and seems to be going for an all-out war.」

628:t_3:48.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Damn...! We finally drove the Empire out, and now Earth is suddenly in danger again!」

628:t_3:49.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「$$バアル$$... humanity's natural enemy...」

628:t_3:50.en:
$$シリウス$$
「So their power far exceeds anything humanity can imagine...」

628:t_3:51.en:
$$アルト$$
(Our song reached the $$バジュラ$$... But the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$... is it no good...)

628:t_3:53.en:
$$ランカ$$
(If fighting like this goes on, $$アルト$$ and Big Bro will end up...)

628:t_3:63.en:
???
「$$ティエリア・アーデ$$... You have lost your body.」

628:t_3:64.en:
???
「However, the memories of you as an $$イノベイド$$, your mind, so to speak, are saved as a backup in this $$ヴェーダ$$.」

628:t_3:65.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$リボンズ・アルマーク$$...! No... an $$イノベイド$$ of the same type as him!」

628:t_3:66.en:
???
「Welcome to the true plan of $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$. I will guide you... and then humanity.」

628:t_3:67.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$イオリア$$'s... true plan...」

628:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...As I thought, that gravity tremor is something different from the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ hyperspace jump.」

628:t_10:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「...Understood. We will handle the rest of the investigation on our end.」

628:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please do. We have the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ business to attend to here.」

628:t_10:7.en:
$$トライア$$
「Doing business even at a time like this... The grit of a dimensional merchant leaves me amazed.」

628:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Collecting even a few more $$Ｚチップ$$ is my top priority, after all.」

628:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That said, this time I truly think it is dangerous, so the congratulations for our ace pilots will have to wait for another occasion...」

628:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I wonder whether the people of Earth will really be able to overcome this trial...」

629:t_001:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$バスター軍団$$...! They have dwindled so much!」

629:t_001:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Stand back! We will handle the rest!」

629:t_002:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「The $$バスター軍団$$... they have totally fallen for $$カズミ$$, huh.」

629:t_002:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Well, she is $$ノリコ$$'s Big Sis, after all.」
